text: 上周，A股市场震荡修复，主要指数周线悉数收涨。市场结构性分化特征突出，资金高低切换、风格均衡化的交易信号显现。券商策略展望报告认为，近期监管部门与央国企密集释放增持、回购等稳市信号，叠加流动性压力缓解，市场已具备筑底基础。展望后市，行情重心正加速向半年度业绩验证转移，建议投资者均衡配置，同时在科技成长内部分化中寻觅结构性机会。
text_en: Last week, A-shares recovered with all major indices closing positive. Structural differentiation was prominent, with rotation and style rebalancing signals emerging. Broker strategy reports believe recent stabilizing signals from regulators and state-owned enterprises, plus easing liquidity pressure, have laid a foundation for bottoming. Looking ahead, focus shifts to H1 earnings verification; balanced allocation is advised, with opportunities in tech growth internal divergence.
